title: Portable Clothesline 8 m – Adjustable for Camping
descriptionHtml:
Dry your clothes wherever you are

On the road and at the campsite, wet clothes and towels quickly become a problem. With nowhere to hang them, they stay damp and start to smell.

An adjustable line that comes along

This clothesline is 8 meters long and adjustable. You simply stretch it between two trees or posts and have a drying line in seconds.

Features

  • 8 meters long and adjustable
  • Easy to stretch between trees and posts
  • Light and small to pack
  • Good for camping, travel and fishing
  • Durable line that holds

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
